name: Kenka ga Tsuyokute Cool de Tsuyoki no Furyou Kanojo ga Yowai Boku o Kabatte Kegasaremasu
original_name: ケンカが強くてクールで強気の不良彼女が弱い僕を庇って汚されます
source:
ABALONE KISS presents a new netorare AVG under its sublabel, ABALONE KISS * CORE.

Experience the story from two perspectives:

"I", the first-person protagonist, and Nagisa, my beautiful street-tough girlfriend. Nagisa protects me from a gang of guys by getting mercilessly fucked. When I realize she didn't betray she... she sacrificed herself...

I can barely live with the regret. Her tears, her words, her cruel behavior, it was all to SAVE me! 

[Edited From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE177449.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
ABALONE KISS旗下子品牌ABALONE KISS * CORE推出全新绿帽AVG。

从两个视角体验故事：

“我”，第一人称主人公；以及我的美丽街头强悍女友渚。渚为了保护我，被一群男人无情地轮奸。当我意识到她并没有背叛，而是……她牺牲了自己……

我几乎无法忍受悔恨。她的泪水、她的话语、她残酷的行为，都是为了救我！
